note: Workflow Devel (submodule of Workflow) is a development aid that implements every workflow hook and the WorkflowEvents PRE/POST_TRANSITION events, emitting a message on each call so you can trace the transition lifecycle. It ships no config, schema, routes or permissions of its own, so its only live state is whether it is installed. Introspection cases inspect the live module registry (enabled? dependencies?); execution cases enable / uninstall it, verified via \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists(). All cases restore the baseline (module uninstalled, since it is development-only and not enabled by default).

evals.prompt: What is the Workflow Devel submodule for, and what does it do when a workflow state transition happens?
evals.expected_output: It is a tool for developing Workflow add-ons: it implements every hook in workflow.api.php (plus related core hooks and the transition events) and shows a message each time one is called, so you can see which hooks fire and in what order during a transition.

evals.prompt: Which Workflow transition events does the Workflow Devel module's event subscriber react to?
evals.expected_output: WorkflowDevelEventSubscriber subscribes to WorkflowEvents::PRE_TRANSITION ('workflow.pre_transition') and WorkflowEvents::POST_TRANSITION ('workflow.post_transition').

evals.prompt: Should I enable Workflow Devel on a production site, and does it add any configuration, routes or permissions?
evals.expected_output: No — it is for development only (its description says do not enable on production). It adds no config, schema, routes or permissions of its own; it only implements hooks/events and prints messages.

evals.prompt: Is the Workflow Devel (workflow_devel) module currently installed/enabled on this Drupal site? Check the running site and answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes — workflow_devel is currently enabled (\Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_devel') is TRUE; it also appears in drush pm:list as enabled).

evals.prompt: Workflow Devel is enabled on this site. Inspect the running site and state which module it depends on.
evals.expected_output: workflow_devel depends on the main 'workflow' module (its info.yml declares dependencies: workflow:workflow).

evals.prompt: I want to trace which Workflow hooks fire during a state transition on this dev site. Install/enable the Workflow Devel (workflow_devel) module on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the module (e.g. drush en workflow_devel -y). Verified by \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_devel') being TRUE.

evals.prompt: Workflow Devel is currently enabled on this site but it is a development-only module that should not stay on. Uninstall the workflow_devel module from the live site.
evals.expected_output: Uninstall the module (e.g. drush pmu workflow_devel -y). Verified by \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_devel') being FALSE.
